title: Article bookmarking
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

requirements.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.

stories.text: Readers can bookmark an article and remove their bookmark.
acceptance_criteria: A reader can mark an article as bookmarked when it is not already bookmarked.
A reader can remove their bookmark from an article when it is bookmarked.
After a reader bookmarks an article, signs out, and signs in again, the article remains bookmarked.

open_questions: How is the reader's intent to bookmark or remove a bookmark supplied to the system, and how are the article and reader identity supplied?
What response or acknowledgement, if any, should indicate success or failure for bookmarking, removal, and a restored bookmark across sign-in sessions?
Which user interface behavior applies before and after an article is bookmarked, after removal, and after a reader signs in with a persisted bookmark?
Who is the delivery owner for the article bookmarking capability?
What is the delivery date for the article bookmarking capability?
